name: PsychiXX -Kinki no Koi-
source: The protagonist is an average detective who gets involved in a series of mysterious murders, where all the victims carry curious wounds. As she investigates into the case, she'll get involved with people with curious abilities, and eventually she'll also have to fight for her life...
